mapper.select: SELECT p.USR_SN, u.USR_NM, f.FL_PATH AS PROFILE_IMAGE_URL, p.PRV_PRF_FL_SN, p.PRV_PRF_INTRO_CN, p.PRV_PRF_AREA_NM, p.PRV_PRF_RVW_AVG_SCR, p.PRV_PRF_RVW_CNT FROM PROVIDER_PROFILE p JOIN USERS u ON u.USR_SN = p.USR_SN LEFT JOIN FILES f ON f.FL_SN = COALESCE(p.PRV_PRF_FL_SN, u.USR_PRFL_FL_SN) AND f.FL_USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE p.USR_SN = #{userSn} AND p.PRV_PRF_USE_YN = 'Y' AND u.USR_USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT c.CAT_NM FROM PROVIDER_CATEGORY_PERMISSION permission JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = permission.CAT_SN WHERE permission.USR_SN = #{userSn} AND permission.PRV_CAT_PRM_STATUS_CD = 'PRVC0006' AND permission.PRV_CAT_PRM_USE_YN = 'Y' AND c.CAT_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY c.CAT_SORT_NO, c.CAT_SN
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROVIDER_PROFILE (USR_SN, PRV_PRF_INTRO_CN, PRV_PRF_AREA_NM, PRV_PRF_FL_SN, PRV_PRF_REG_ID, PRV_PRF_UPDT_ID) VALUES (#{userSn}, #{introduction}, #{availableArea}, #{profileFileSn}, #{actorId}, #{actorId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE PRV_PRF_INTRO_CN = VALUES(PRV_PRF_INTRO_CN), PRV_PRF_AREA_NM = VALUES(PRV_PRF_AREA_NM), PRV_PRF_FL_SN = VALUES(PRV_PRF_FL_SN), PRV_PRF_USE_YN = 'Y', PRV_PRF_UPDT_ID = VALUES(PRV_PRF_UPDT_ID)
mapper.update: UPDATE PROVIDER_PROFILE SET PRV_PRF_RVW_AVG_SCR = #{averageScore}, PRV_PRF_RVW_CNT = #{reviewCount}, PRV_PRF_UPDT_ID = #{actorId}, PRV_PRF_UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USR_SN = #{userSn}
mapper.select: SELECT USR_SN FROM PROVIDER_PROFILE WHERE USR_SN = #{userSn} FOR UPDATE
